subject: MAP launch plan: EU cross-border data residency — stakeholder roster & timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anna Karlsson <anna.karlsson@scandibank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: MAP launch plan: EU cross-border data residency — stakeholder roster & timeline

Hi Anna + team,

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, wed like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get alignment across security, legal, and product on the EU cross-border/data-localization review and to lock a pragmatic close timeline. Goal is a 6-week evaluation window with clear deliverables so your procurement and legal teams can make a decision with concrete artifacts.

Proposed MAP sections (attached: MAP_EU_Template_v2.xlsx):
- Scope & systems in-scope (initially: customer-facing inference endpoints, telemetry exports, and S3 backups)
- Success criteria (data residency constraints, acceptable cross-border flows, encryption + key management checks)
- Roles & RACI (security, legal, infra, vendor engagement)
- Milestones & dates (discovery, evaluation, evidence handoff, exec review)
- Evaluation plan (prompt sets, quality/regression checks, performance SLOs)

As next steps: could you please confirm the primary internal owners at ScandiBank for Security and Legal, and any additional stakeholders we should include? Weve tentatively proposed:
- Redwood DRI: Soojin Lee (technical MAP coordinator)
- Redwood compliance lead: Jonas Weber (evidence & SOC2 owner)
- Redwood infra reviewer: Marissa Cole (deployment controls)
- Redwood evaluation lead: Laura Bennett (quality & eval plans)

Draft milestone timeline (flexible):
- 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25: Discovery & data inventory
- 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-05: Evaluation & evidence collection
- 2026-11-08: Exec review / close checkpoint

Can you confirm the ScandiBank owners and whether the timeline above works? If so well schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue/Oct 20 to walk through the tracker and RACI (calendar invite to follow).

Attachments: MAP_EU_Template_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook)

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Anna — happy to shift the discovery window. Updated plan below and a short evaluation checklist so everyone knows the expected outputs. Ive attached our evaluation prompt set and the data inventory template for reference.

Updated milestones (agreed):
- 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-29: Discovery & data inventory (ScandiBank to fill inventory template)
- 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-10: Evaluation + evidence collection (Redwood will run prompt/regression checks; ScandiBank provides access to records requested)
- 2026-11-12: Exec review and close checkpoint (target)

Evaluation checklist (high level):
- Data inventory completed (fields, retention, regions, endpoints) — owner: ScandiBank Legal/Security
- Evidence: SOC2 summary, network egress controls, KMS configuration snapshots — owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood) + ScandiBank infra
- Functional/regression evaluation: prompt sets & quality thresholds (see evaluation_prompt_set_v1.json) — owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood)
- Acceptable cross-border flows doc: draft by ScandiBank Legal — owner: Paul Schäfer

DRI assignments (Redwood):
- Soojin Lee — MAP coordinator / day-to-day contact
- Jonas Weber — compliance evidence & logs (SOC2, audit trails)
- Marissa Cole — infra review and deployment controls
- Laura Bennett — evaluation suite owner

Ive also created a MAP tracker (link below) and pre-populated the first tab with the milestones above. Please add ScandiBanks owners and baseline dates in the tracker so we can export for procurement if needed.

Thanks all — I can take point on compiling the compliance evidence set. Quick notes:
- I will prepare the SOC2 summary, a redacted audit log bundle, and an export of KMS config by Nov 3 so it fits your revised window.
- For the data inventory: could you confirm whether you need per-field lineage (e.g., PII flags) or just dataset-level retention/region? Per-field will add more work on your side; dataset-level is usually sufficient for initial legal review.

Booking: Ill accept the 30-min kickoff invite once Soojin posts it — prefer Tue Oct 20 @ 10:00am CET if that still works for the ScandiBank team.
